summary: This session from Zadul-Ma'ad (Provisions for the Hereafter) discusses the proper etiquette and conduct when entering the Masjid. Sh. Ali Mashhour explains the concept of Tahiyyatul-Masjid (the salutation prayer of the Masjid), which is a recommended practice of praying at least two raka'ah upon entering the Masjid to honor its sacred status. The lecture clarifies that this greeting prayer is not strictly two raka'ah but rather the principle of initiating one's time in the Masjid with prayer. Additionally, Sh. Ali Mashhour covers the importance of extending greetings (Assalamu alaikum) to others in the Masjid and how to properly convey salutations, including detailed guidance on greeting those who may be sleeping or engaged in other activities.
